2–3 hours (plus the time to gather 17 talismans; the boss has a 20 h cooldown)

A sinister bat in Edron leads you to the vampire {npc:Anaztassja Moroia}, who wants to stop {creature:Vladrukh}, the father of vampires, and his army of Norcferatu (vampire orcs) in {wiki:Vengoth}. You calm the orcs' ancestral spirits with the Ritual Dance of the Red Moon, receive a blood baptism, lure a Behemoth with talismans to break the defence of the {wiki:Norcferatu Fortress}, protect Anaztassja during a ritual, destroy a shaman's heart from the inside and, at the end, kill Vladrukh. You receive the {wiki:Gloom Maw (Mount)|Gloom Maw} mount, the achievement **Bat Person** and the right to use the Mysterious Machine that takes you to the fortress entrance.

A dark and unholy union between orcs and vampires gave rise to a terrifying hybrid race: the Norcferatu. The orcs of this region had a proud warrior culture, guided by shamans, but vampiric corruption crept into their clans and Vladrukh, the father of the vampires, twisted their bloodline. The Nightweavers, former shamans, gave themselves over to shadow worship and blood magic; the Heartless tear out their own hearts and keep them in iron amphorae so they can fight without fear of death. The ancestral spirits of the orcs, outraged at seeing their descendants corrupt their heritage, will only help you if you perform the Ritual Dance of the Red Moon, a traditional dance that awakens the fire in the blood.
Level **250**: below that {npc:An Ominous Bat} just glares at you and does not give you the quest.
Access to {wiki:Vengoth}: {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest} done up to mission 4 (*The Dark Lands*), so that {npc:Harlow} takes you to the island.
At least **17** {item:Norcferatu Talisman|Norcferatu Talismans} for the *Breaking in* mission (they can be pooled as a team).
{spell:Levitate} spell: you use it in Edron (down) and to enter the fortress (up).
A team for *The Blood Ritual* (a full team is recommended), *The Belly of the Beast* and the boss {creature:Vladrukh}.
to lure the Behemoth in the Breaking in mission; loot from the Norcferatu Fortress creatures or bought on the Market
or the {spell:Invisible} spell: Vladrukh's Vampire Bats cannot see invisibility
Equipment with **Life Drain** and **Earth** protection for Vladrukh
Possibly a bomb (*bomb*) for the Blood Totem: the spoiler only says *throw a bomb near the Blood Totem*, without saying which one or where to get it
Lots of health and mana potions
100 gp for {npc:Harlow}'s boat to Vengoth (50 gp to return)
{wiki:Gloom Maw (Mount)|Gloom Maw} mount (+10 speed, can be coloured)
You can use the **Mysterious Machine** on the highest floor, which teleports you to the fortress entrance (makes hunting more efficient)

{creature:Vladrukh}'s loot (a 450,000 experience boss): {item:Crystal Coin|Crystal Coins}, {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}, potions and, with luck, {item:Blood Crown}, {item:Blood Sceptre}, {item:Skull Belt}, {item:Greater Proficiency Catalyst}, among others
Mission *Into the Grave*: {npc:Anaztassja Moroia} gives you her magic so you can get through the orcs' protection and enter the lair (go up with {spell:Levitate} after the mist).
Mission *Breaking in*: after the Behemoth breaks the Blood Guardian's defence, enter through the unprotected teleport.
The boss page lists a 20-hour cooldown and a maximum fight time of 15 minutes.
Mysterious Machine on the top floor (teleport to the Norcferatu Fortress entrance)
When you report to {npc:Anaztassja Moroia} after killing Vladrukh.
When you report to {npc:Anaztassja Moroia} after killing Vladrukh (achievement **Bat Person**).

Collect the 17 {item:Norcferatu Talisman|Norcferatu Talismans} before you reach the *Breaking in* mission: they drop from {creature:Dworc Shadowstalker|Dworc Shadowstalkers}, {creature:Gloom Maw|Gloom Maws}, {creature:Norcferatu Heartless}, {creature:Norcferatu Nightweaver|Norcferatu Nightweavers}, {creature:Orclops Bloodbreaker|Orclops Bloodbreakers} and {creature:Varg|Vargs}, or buy them on the Market. In a team, pool the talismans together.

The fortress creatures are very strong (from 5,400 to 10,300 HP); the wiki recommends level 550 to hunt in the {wiki:Norcferatu Dungeons}. Even though the quest is level 250, don't go alone to the combat parts.

Useful team setup for Vladrukh: a {wiki:Knight} to trap the boss in a corner, shooters attacking from a distance and a mage who can summon {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} to block the Blood Pools.
Keep {item:Stealth Ring|Stealth Rings} or {spell:Invisible} on a hotkey: the {creature:Vampire Bat|Vampire Bats} appear several times during Vladrukh.
In *The Belly of the Beast* avoid area attacks: the {creature:Vampiric Flesh} reflect the damage they take.
The quest starts in Edron, next to Telas's house. Have {spell:Levitate} ready.
Take a boat to **Edron** ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}). You arrive at {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s harbour; from there head **east** through the city to the area of {npc:Telas}'s house.
Talk to {npc:An Ominous Bat}: say {key:hi}. The bat tells you that the grave is calling you. If you are below level 250, it only glares at you (*<the bat just glares at you>*).
Go up the stairs to the floor above (floor 6), **directly north** of where {npc:Telas} is.
At this point use {spell:Levitate} **down** (*exani hur down*). You go down to where an ominous grave (*ominous grave*) is.
Use the ominous grave. You are taken to a room one floor below (floor -1), where {npc:Anaztassja Moroia} is.

Say {key:hi}. She says she is glad you finally answered her {key:call}: say that word. Then ask her about the {key:entity}: she tells you that {creature:Vladrukh} and his army of vile orcs obtained preserved blood from an ancient entity. At the end, she grants you her magic so you can get past their protection and enter the lair.
Anaztassja's magic, which lets you enter the Norcferatu lair

The wiki does not describe the exit from this room. Look for the exit in the room itself and go back to Edron harbour, to {npc:Captain Seahorse}, to continue your journey to Vengoth (next section). If you can't find an exit, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} takes you to your city's temple (it does not work in No-Logout zones or with Logout Block / Protection Zone Block).

Go to **Yalahar**. From Edron: {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to Liberty Bay ({key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}, 170 gp) and, in Liberty Bay, {npc:Captain Max} (on one of the boats on the **east** side of the pier) takes you to Yalahar ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}, 400 gp). Captain Max only sails this route after you start the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest}. After that quest's *Searoutes around Yalahar* mission, {npc:Karith} (in Yalahar harbour, one floor up) also connects Yalahar to Ab'Dendriel, Ankrahmun, Carlin, Darashia, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Thais and Venore.

At the docks of Yalahar's **Trade Quarter** (straight **south** from the main gate), talk to {npc:Harlow}: {key:hi}, {key:vengoth}, {key:yes} (100 gp). He drops you off in the **west** of {wiki:Vengoth}.
Walk **north** towards the {wiki:Norcferatu Fortress}. On the way you pass through a mist.

The Norcferatu Fortress has very strong creatures ({creature:Orclops Bloodbreaker|Orclops Bloodbreakers}, {creature:Dworc Shadowstalker|Dworc Shadowstalkers}, {creature:Varg|Vargs}...). Don't go around pulling monsters.

**Don't go up the stairs.** Instead, right after the mist, a little **east** of the stairs, use {spell:Levitate} **up** (*exani hur up*) at this point. You go up to floor 6 and meet {npc:Anaztassja Moroia} again.
Say {key:hi} and {key:business} to Anaztassja. She asks you to find the ancestral cave and a way to communicate with the ancestral spirits of the orcs.
Go through the quest door **next to** Anaztassja and walk **east** to another quest door. Go through it as well.
Talk to {npc:An Orchish Ancestor Spirit}: say {key:hi} and {key:appease}. The spirit tells you that you must appease them to earn their support: you have to dance to honour the rites of their people.
You must perform the *Ritual Dance of the Red Moon* to receive the spirits' blessing.
Enter the room and stand on one of the ominous marks (*ominous mark*) on the floor.
Turn your character as fast as you can (turn it in every direction with **Ctrl + arrow keys**). A counter appears next to your character and goes up to **50**.
Don't stand next to the **Angry Orc Ancestor Spirits** (angry spirits in the room): they often make you {wiki:Drunk|drunk}, {wiki:Rooted|rooted} or {wiki:Feared|feared}, and that ruins the dance.
When you reach 50 the message *YOU HAVE APPEASED THE ORCISH ANCESTORS!* appears. The ritual is complete.
Go back **west** through the two quest doors to Anaztassja and say {key:hi} and {key:business}.
Anaztassja tells you that you need a blood baptism to fool the protections of the deepest dungeons.
Go up and enter through the quest door
Go up **one floor** (floor 5) and enter the room protected by a quest door.
Quest door to the Blind Monstrosity room
This room is guarded by a {creature:Blind Monstrosity}. Be quick, or use a good strategy, and cross the room without being hit by its attacks until you reach the next room, to the **east**.

According to the creature's page, the Blind Monstrosity has a fixed movement pattern and does not deal damage to players; even so, the spoiler says not to get hit by its attacks. Watch the pattern before crossing.
In the room to the east is the {creature:Blood Totem}. Throw a bomb (*bomb*) next to it.
The spoiler only says *throw a bomb near the Blood Totem* and does not say which bomb it is or where to get it: first check whether there is one in the room before using up your own runes.

Let the Blood Totem's spells hit you until the sacrament is complete: a counter appears and goes up to **10**. The messages *Argh!*, *That Pain!!*, *<gasp>* appear and, at the end, *You gained the sacrament of blood!*.
According to the Blood Totem's page, it does not move and does not deal damage to players.

Go back the same way: cross the Blind Monstrosity room again to the **west**, leave through the quest door and go down one floor to Anaztassja. Talk to her ({key:hi}). The spoiler only says *report back to Anaztassja* and does not give the report keyword; if she doesn't react, use {key:business}, the keyword from the previous reports in the fortress.
This mission can be done as a team: work together to collect the talismans.

Anaztassja smells the orc blood on you and confirms that everything is ready. The last obstacle before the underground floors is getting past a {creature:Blood Guardian}. Her plan: use {item:Norcferatu Talisman|Norcferatu Talismans} to lure a {creature:Behemoth} that will break through their guard.
Walk a little to the **north-west** and enter a narrow corridor from which you can see the guardian on the floor below. Follow the corridor to the end, to the **east**.

Start throwing the talismans to the floor below, beginning with the **easternmost** square, and keep luring the Behemoth to the far **west**. It has to be done **square by square**, so you need at least **17** talismans.
With fewer than 17 talismans you can't lead the Behemoth all the way. In a team, pool everyone's talismans.
Go down and enter the teleport
When the Behemoth breaks the wall, you and any other player who wants to progress in the quest have **5 minutes** to run downstairs and enter the now unprotected teleport.
You only have 5 minutes: anyone who doesn't get in on time is left behind.
You go to the underground area (the {wiki:Norcferatu Dungeons}) looking for Anaztassja. Follow the route, floor by floor.
You arrive on floor -1. Walk to the marked point to the **south** and go down to floor -2.
Walk **north-west** to the marked point and go down to floor -3.
Say {key:hi} and ask about the next step ({key:step}). She tells you that she is going to break the last seals protecting the orcs' cabal, but needs you to protect her while she does it.
Enter the teleport and join your team for the next task.
It is recommended to do this mission with a **full team**. If you fail, you can only try again **1 hour** later.
As you enter you see Anaztassja, three sinister signs on the floor and two boxes. Each sign gives players an **automatic** spell that can be upgraded:
Trap that triggers when creatures walk over it
Take the items from the boxes
The **north** box gives you an {item:Empowered Stake}, to deal damage to creatures next to you (melee). The **south** box gives you a {item:Vial of Corrosive Blood}, to deal damage at range.

Walk **west** along the corridor until you find a mist. You cannot pass through it. Creatures come out of the mist and try to move **east** to kill Anaztassja: your goal is to kill them before that, with everything you have (the signs' spells, the items from the boxes and your own attacks).
The most common one. Fast but easy to kill. You can block its path with your body to slow it down.
Slower but with more HP and more damage than the minions. Causes {wiki:Feared|fear} to anyone nearby. **Prioritise it**: its corpse upgrades the players' spells (step on the body after it dies).
The final boss and the last creature to appear. Focus all your damage on it: it kills Anaztassja in a single hit.
After you kill a Norcferatu Abomination, step on its corpse to upgrade your automatic spell.
When the {creature:Norcferatu Monstrosity} appears, the whole team attacks it. When it dies, the mission is complete.
If the Monstrosity reaches Anaztassja, it kills her in a single hit and you fail the mission (you can only retry 1 hour later).
Talk to Anaztassja again ({key:hi}) to report the mission.

Leave the ritual room (the spoiler only says *leave the current location*, without describing the exit) and go back to the spot where you talked to Anaztassja on floor -3 ({coord:32882,31423,10}). From there follow the route to the new place where she is waiting for you, on floor -4 (going through floor -1 first).
From Anaztassja's spot, walk a little **north** and go up to floor -2.
Walk **south-east** and go up to floor -1.
Walk **north-east** to the marked spot and go down to floor -2.
Take a few steps **south-east** and go down to floor -3.
Walk **south-west** and go down to floor -4.
Say {key:hi} and {key:shaman}. She tells you that you must kill the shaman **from the inside**: let him swallow you and then destroy his vile heart.

Risky mission because of the damage reflection and the agony damage. If you are not sure you can take the damage, be careful and avoid area attacks. There is a **10-minute** limit: after that time you are kicked out.

Enter the room **east** of Anaztassja and step on the pool of blood. You end up in a lever room (*lever room*), which is the way into the last part: destroying the shaman's heart. Gather the team there before moving on. The spoiler does not explain how the lever works or how many players can enter.
From here you have **10 minutes**; when the time runs out you are kicked out.
The goal is to cross the room surviving the creatures and destroy the {creature:Vampiric Heart} at the very end. You will face:
Damages anyone who steps on it. It disappears from time to time, so you can avoid it.
Reflects the damage it takes: do not attack many at the same time.
Normal creatures that attack in melee. They respawn quickly after being killed.
Immobile and with all the effects of the other creatures. Its constant area earth attack reaches 4 squares at most.
Attack the {creature:Vampiric Heart}. Shooters can stay **5 squares** away: its earth attack only reaches 4, and that way they also avoid the {creature:Digestive Fluid} in the room.
If the team struggles to attack the heart while holding off the {creature:Digestive Ooze|Digestive Oozes}, lure them away first.
When the heart is destroyed you get a quest log update. Leave through the teleport **south** of where the heart was and talk to Anaztassja ({key:hi}) to report.
Anaztassja tells you the time has come to face the usurper vampire and destroy him for good. The fight alternates between two phases until the end.

Equip protection against **Life Drain** and **Earth**. Have {item:Stealth Ring|Stealth Rings} or {spell:Invisible} on a hotkey for the Vampire Bats. Agree beforehand on who holds the boss (the {wiki:Knight}), who deals with the Blood Pools and who kills the essences.
According to the boss page, the fight lasts at most **15 minutes** and each character can only face it once every **20 hours**.
Enter the room **west** of Anaztassja and get ready: {creature:Vladrukh} is inside.

In the first phase (the starting one) Vladrukh is in the room and, shortly after, three {creature:Blood Pool|Blood Pools} appear. Usually the Knight pulls the boss into a corner, facing a side where his frequent **waves** do not hit the shooters. In this phase the team has about **2 minutes and 20 seconds** to attack the boss.
Vladrukh casts waves very often: shooters, never stand in front of him.

Shooters can tank the {creature:Blood Pool|Blood Pools}, but it is safer to lure them away from the boss and have a mage summon {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} to block them. The spoiler explains that the pools only attack with Life Drain, and Demon Skeletons are immune to that damage.

The Blood Pool page says that a patch on 2 September 2025 changed its attacks from Life Drain to **physical** damage: the Demon Skeletons still block the path, but they may no longer be immune to the damage.

After the 2 minutes and 20 seconds Vladrukh disappears and four {creature:Vampire Bat|Vampire Bats} and four {creature:Vampiric Essence|Vampiric Essences} appear (the Blood Pools do **not** disappear). Kill the four Vampiric Essences (about 20 000 HP each) as fast as possible to go back to phase 1.
While you are busy with the essences, Vladrukh heals. The longer you take, the more health he recovers.

The {creature:Vampire Bat|Vampire Bats} are dangerous: they are immortal, make you {wiki:Drunk|drunk}, cause {wiki:Feared|fear}, reflect all the damage they take and ignore the Knight's {spell:Challenge}. But they **cannot see invisibility**: put on a {item:Stealth Ring} or use {spell:Invisible} as soon as they appear.
Do not attack the Vampire Bats: they reflect 100% of the damage.
Alternate between phase 1 (attack Vladrukh) and phase 2 (kill the essences) until the boss reaches **red** health.

At red health, Vladrukh gains an extra temporary form: he turns into a poison field for a few seconds. In that form he is **immortal** and deals considerably more damage. Knights can use those seconds to run around the room with the boss (as long as it is safe for them and for the shooters; remember the frequent waves) and then hold him in place again.
It is just a mechanic to delay the end of the fight: hold on, do not waste damage while he is immortal.
Keep dealing damage until Vladrukh dies. The boss gives 450 000 experience. Some of the possible loot (data from few samples on the wiki):

After you kill {creature:Vladrukh}, leave the boss room (the spoiler does not describe the exit) and talk to {npc:Anaztassja Moroia} one last time ({key:hi}; the spoiler does not give the report keyword). You get the {wiki:Gloom Maw (Mount)|Gloom Maw} mount and the **Bat Person** achievement. You can also now use the **Mysterious Machine** on the top floor, which teleports you to the fortress entrance.
Gloom Maw mount, Bat Person achievement and access to the Mysterious Machine

Go back up the way you came down (the route from section 9 in reverse: on floor -4 go to {coord:32911,31440,11} and go up; on floor -3 go to {coord:32935,31425,10} and go up; on floor -2 go to {coord:32929,31421,9} and go up to floor -1). On floor -1 you are back in the area where you arrived by teleport ({coord:32912,31428,8}). The wiki does not describe how to get out of the dungeons to the fortress or the exact position of the **Mysterious Machine**: it only says that the machine is on the top floor and that, after the quest, it teleports you to the entrance of the {wiki:Norcferatu Fortress}.
If you cannot find the exit, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} takes you to your city's temple (it does not work in No-Logout zones or with Logout Block / Protection Zone Block).
If you end up on floor 6 of the entrance (where Anaztassja was in *Through the Mist*), go down the same way you came up: use {spell:Levitate} **down** next to the spot where you levitated up.

From the fortress entrance walk **south**, the same way you came, to {npc:Harlow} in the **west** of Vengoth. Say {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes} (50 gp) to go back to the docks of Yalahar's Trade Quarter. From there take a boat to your city ({npc:Karith}, in Yalahar's harbour, if you have done the *Searoutes around Yalahar* mission).
The **Bat Person** achievement is worth 3 points, requires Premium and is not secret (*No matter your command, this beast is all ears!*).
The {wiki:Gloom Maw (Mount)|Gloom Maw} mount can only be obtained through this quest and is not sold in the Store.
If you fail *The Blood Ritual*, you can repeat the mission 1 hour later. *The Belly of the Beast* has a 10-minute limit.
{creature:Vladrukh} is an **Archfoe** class boss in the Bosstiary, sees invisibility and walks through fire, energy and poison fields. He has nothing to do with the NPC Vladruc.
Any leftover {item:Norcferatu Talisman|Norcferatu Talismans} can be sold to {npc:Yasir} for 670 gp or on the Market.
